## Install on Windows 10 or 11

1. Download the file ending in `_x64-setup.exe` below. It installs for your user only and doesn't need admin rights.
2. The installer isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say **"Windows protected your PC"**. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. If WebView2 is missing (rare on Windows 11), the installer downloads it.

Already installed? Run the new installer over the old one; your progress is kept. Your data lives in `%APPDATA%\com.keepitsimpleanalytics.morsetrainer`, and uninstalling keeps it unless you tick "Delete the application data".

The `.dmg` is a **macOS build that has not been tested**. It isn't notarised: if macOS refuses to open it, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
